title: Mississippi appeals court upholds 2003 will, leaving most of estate to cousins
summary_full: A recent legal battle over Lamar DeLoach's estate concluded with the Court of Appeals affirming his 2003 will. Frank DeLoach argued that he had destroyed a later version, but the court ruled that, without a valid 2012 will, the original remains in effect. Court-appointed co-executors Larry and Rodney DeLoach are tasked with estate management, highlighting the critical nature of adhering to proper legal procedures in will creation and revocation.
